notes.title: Patch 2.1
notes.content: [p]Hello everyone![/p][p]Today we have pushed a quick patch update which fixes the following bugs:[/p][list][*][p]Left hand alignment.[/p][/*][*][p]Mods persistence: We made the necessary changes to make sure your mods stay persistent between updates from now on. Please always back up your mods folder just in case.[/p][/*][/list][p]As always, please report back any issues or suggestions you might have and we will do our best to address them asap.[/p][p][/p][p]With Love,[/p][p]vHand team[/p]

notes.title: The Summer Major Update 2.0 has landed!
notes.content: [h2]Hello vHand Artists,[/h2][p][/p][p]We are happy to announce vHand major update 2.0, which includes a new stickers systems, more fluid hand and items motion with physics integration, press animation, extra assets, new background color setup in settings menu, improved UI, new setup guides and more![/p][p][/p][p]Let's dive into the update notes![/p][p][/p][p][i]With love,[/i][/p][p][i]-vHand Team[/i][/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="kC1mshApeFk;full"][/previewyoutube][p][/p][h2]Introducing Stickers System[/h2][p]Now you can add and use your favorite PNG images as stickers into the app! We made it very easy for you to add any PNG images into the "StreamingAssets/Items" folder, and they will appear in the app under the newly added Items tab.[/p][p][/p][p]Stickers can be attached to any moving part of the hand or simply placed on the background as a still image.[/p][p][/p][p]Stickers can be:[/p][list][*][p]Adjusted by draw order[/p][/*][*][p]Scaled up and down using mouse scroll wheel[/p][/*][*][p]Rotated using 'R' key + mouse scroll wheel[/p][/*][*][p]Deleted using 'D' key + press[/p][/*][*][p]Moved around by press and drag[/p][/*][*][p]Placed in multiple order[/p][/*][*][p]Automatically saved under each preset[/p][/*][/list][p]We have also added a "Remove all items" button to bulk deleted all stickers on the scene.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45221255/add32387a7aad1fc3c375ae02d1c4472b2c3fd23.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]Physics [/h2][p]Hand and items movements are more fluid thanks to the newly added physics integration. It is enabled by default and you don't need to do anything extra.[/p][p][/p][p]We have also added a new press animation to further enhance the realism of the hand motion and it works for all current hand types.[/p][p][/p][h2]Extra Assets[/h2][p]More assets has been added to the app, including three sleeve options, one new pen, default stickers images and new claw nails.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][h2]Optimizations[/h2][p]We have heard your feedback regarding the app slow launching time so we fixed that. The app should now start much faster. We have also made several other optimizations to keep the app running smoothly.[/p][p][/p][h2]Background Color[/h2][p]You can now change the app background color by going into settings and then systems. You can set any color from the color picker. This also works for MAC OS users.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45221255/3990aa7575a1ba65b83331b0361c7e2ea776b404.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2]UI Tweaks AND Guides[/h2][p]We slightly reduced the width size of the customization UI to make the interface more user friendly and we added in-app guide menu to quickly take you to different setup and tutorial pages.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45221255/f5fede0e3d56b8c72f67b0bf773d241013179878.png"][/img][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: 1.2 Update now Available
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

We are excited to announce our new major update which includes the much requested Mods support!
You can now access all the textures, edit any of the pens, accessories, hands, etc... and your edits will show up on the app once restarted. Watch the video tutorial for how to.

[h1]1.2 Changelog[/h1]
[list]
[*] Added Mods Support
[*] Color picker now saves your selected color automatically every time.
[*] Increased the range of the hand scale slider.
[/list]

[h1]Mods Tutorial Video:[/h1]

https://x.com/ColdiArt/status/1869804893315518902

notes.title: 1.1 Update Now Available
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

Here is our first major vHand update. We hope you've been enjoying the app so far, we heard your feedback and we made sure to include as many great new features as possible. Thank you for using our product!
-Coldi
 
[h1]1.1 Changelog:[/h1]

[b]IMPORTANT: This update adds many changes, if you encounter a problem changing the color of a customization parameter, please go to settings, system, and click on "Reset Presets". This will erase the old presets and resets everything back to default. Make sure you restart the application.[/b]
 
[h2]New features:[/h2]

[list]
[*] New male hand design added, with shorter nails.
[*] Added ability to customize hand size ( scale it down or up) using slider under settings, general tab.
[*] Added new toggle to enable or disable preset shortcuts globally from the settings menu under general tab. They are now OFF by default.
[*] Added the following assets : Chibi forearm, Furry forearm, Furry Stripes, Index and Thumb Rings , Bracelet, Hand Mesh, Full Gloves, Fingerless Gloves, Opera Gloves.
[*] Added new setting to restrict hand inside the app window Under settings, system tab, for multi-screen users.
[*] Added "Reset Presets" button under settings, system tab. Use that button to reset everything back to default. Useful if you encounter any issues after a major update.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45221255/f0b073c3b2da7af26e7b576155e112052026b257.gif[/img] 

[h2]Improvements:[/h2]

[list]
[*] Improved customization UI by rearranging the tabs into clearer categories for better navigation.
[*] Improved customization UI by disabling sliders on color only parameters
[*] Increased sound max volume.
[*] Improved sketching sound dynamics
[*] Made hand always visible on the foreground.
[*] Press effects and sound can now be previewed even when customization UI is open.
[/list]

Multiple hand selection, including female and male variants.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45221255/6a0b4ad107254cc785d33f171b62c413f4d32e56.gif[/img] 

[h2]Bug fixes:[/h2]

[list]
[*] Fixed random up key bug on scroll menus.
[/list]

Please visit [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/3192760/discussions/3/4691153988129619271/]OBS Setup Tutorial[/url] to setup your vHand properly for streaming.
